note: Curated download candidates for a 32GB-VRAM / 64GB-RAM (discrete GPU) box, aimed at coding + generative work (logic, financial/marketing prose, analysis, documents, and code-driven charts/widgets/artifacts). Source of truth for docs/candidate-models.md. approxWeightsBytes is the on-disk GGUF size at the listed quant (raw bytes, GiB-based, approximate); real KV/context fit must still be measured with `npm run calibrate`. Sizes and repos verified against public GGUF releases as of 2026-01; confirm the exact file before downloading.

models.name: Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct
models.why: Best local coder in this footprint; excellent self-contained HTML/React artifacts and chart code. Q4_K_M leaves ample VRAM for a large context window.

models.name: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct
models.why: Coder-tuned MoE — very fast on a 32GB GPU because only ~3B params are active. Strong at tool-use and iterating on widgets/artifacts.

models.name: Qwen3-32B
models.why: Strongest all-round open model in this class for reasoning + code + structured prose. Thinking model — run `npm run sweep` to cap the reasoning budget before trusting it for documents/charts.

models.name: Qwen3-30B-A3B
models.why: Fast MoE daily driver — ~3B active means high tokens/sec on this GPU. Thinking model; cap the reasoning budget with `npm run sweep`.

models.name: Gemma-3-27B-it
models.why: Best-in-class prose/tone for marketing & financial writing; multimodal so it can read charts/images. Note the higher per-token KV — measure context fit with calibrate.

models.name: Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct
models.why: Fast, no forced 'thinking' tax, superb instruction-following. Reliable for document/JSON generation and structured output.

models.name: GLM-4-32B-0414
models.why: Notably strong at single-file front-end web artifacts and interactive widgets.

models.name: Codestral-22B-v0.1
models.why: Strong, fast, permissive fill-in-the-middle for editor-style completion workflows.

models.name: Phi-4 (14B)
models.why: Punches above its weight on structured reasoning/analysis. Q8_0 fits easily and leaves the most VRAM of any pick for a large context window.
